recommendation.rationale: QA Pilot production Lane A (receipt schema) is complete and validated under the QA Pilot project ledger. All 4 packet types defined. All 12 PR rules enforced. Schema extends evidence kinds with 2 production-specific kinds (schema_validation, hash_verification). Real SHA-256 hashing replaces dry-run placeholders. Librarian receipt bridge established. Caveats: MCP tooling (Lane B) and hash verification tooling not yet implemented.
